describe: A map from Pluckk's map library (/maps/<id>.json). In prompt it fills the region `highlight` and/or dots the point `mark`. In respond the user clicks once: a point `target` {lat, lon} scores exp(-km / tolerance_km), where tolerance defaults to 6% of the map's diagonal; a region `target` {region} scores 1 inside, 0 outside. On reveal the target shows (with `label`) beside the click.

highlight.description: Region id to fill, e.g. CN-GD

label.description: Name drawn at the target on reveal
